final: WITH per_race AS (SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS entries, SUM(points) AS total_points FROM constructorResults GROUP BY raceId), avg_e AS (SELECT AVG(entries) AS a FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceId, c.country, p.total_points, p.entries, p.entries - avg_e.a AS diff_from_avg FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN avg_e LEFT JOIN races r ON r.raceId = p.raceId LEFT JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE p.entries > avg_e.a ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
